comment: Repos excluded from the site everywhere: the builds grid, the commit feed, the stats, and the committed snapshot. Read by both lib/github.ts and scripts/sync-github.mjs so the two can't drift. Two reasons a repo lands here: it's an interview take-home assessment rather than my own work, or it's old enough that I'd rather it not represent me. Listing a repo here is safe whether or not it still exists on GitHub, so these entries stay put after a repo is deleted.
